spellbook.finance/limitations: A day with no point means SpellBook stored no buylist row for it. It never means the dealer stopped buying or that the price was zero.
earliestDay is the first stored day. Days before it are unknown, and an empty series says no stored buylist rows exist for the printing.
Only Card Kingdom and Cardhoarder appear in this series. A missing vendor field on a day means no stored value for that vendor on that day.
Points are stored observations in USD. They are not quotes and do not reserve a card, submit a buylist or move money.

annotations.title: Read one card's dealer buylist history

description: Read the stored daily dealer buylist price series for ONE exact printing: one point per day with the Card Kingdom and Cardhoarder buylist price when SpellBook stored one, oldest day first, plus earliestDay, the first day SpellBook holds any stored row for that printing. Use the printing id from spellbook_printings_search. Call spellbook_card_buylist for current offers from every dealer SpellBook reads. This read returns facts; it does not choose a vendor, judge a price or sell cards.

cardId.description: The exact printing id from spellbook_printings_search. Required.

days.description: How many days back to read, 1 to 180. Omit for the longest window SpellBook returns.
